_doc: The Paragraph panel writes the POINT-TEXT anchor (council 2026-10-01, O25).
transcripts/PARAGRAPH.md §Storage: alignment of point text is `text-anchor` on
the <text> element, never the paragraph wrapper; the sub-mapping is
ALIGN_LEFT -> start, ALIGN_CENTER -> middle, ALIGN_RIGHT -> end, and `start` is
the identity value, so it is OMITTED (the field reads ""). The justify buttons
are grayed for point text and fall through to start.
Swift (ParagraphAnchorCorpusTests). Each vector loads `setup_svg`, selects the
children of layer 0 named in `select`, seeds the Paragraph panel with `panel`,
runs the panel apply, and reads `text_anchor` off every child of layer 0 in
order. `null` in `expected` names a child with NO anchor field (text on a path:
the model carries none, so the panel has nothing to write there).
THE CHILDREN: 0 point text, no anchor · 1 point text, anchor end · 2 AREA text
with anchor end (area text aligns by the wrapper's text-align and ignores the
anchor, so the panel leaves it as the file had it) · 3 text on a path · 4 point
text, anchor end, NEVER selected (the apply touches only the selection).
